name: liquid-glass-sidebar-menu
blurb: Frosted glass sidebar menu with glow and blur effects.
description: Sidebar with liquid glass styling (blur, shadow, glow). Icon + text buttons. Draggable component. Supports customization via LiquidGlassCard props.
use_when: Modern dashboards or apps where glassmorphism aesthetic fits the brand.
avoid_when: High-contrast or accessibility-first interfaces; blur reduces readability.
a11y: Nav buttons are keyboard-navigable. Icons are semantic. Draggable but not required for access.
